name: Combinatorial Eluder Dimension of the Universal Class
proof: Take $u_n$ as base.  For each $j<n$, use the domain point $\{j\}$ and witness $u_j$: it differs from $u_n$ at $\{j\}$ and agrees with it at all earlier singleton points.  Thus there is a witness of length $n-1$.  Since the class has n hypotheses, the general size bound gives the matching upper bound.
